components.note: 亻 (person) — marks people and their roles, as in 你 you, 们 plural, 信 trust; 储 is a person laying something by, to store, as in 储蓄 savings.
诸 (zhū) — loose sound hint (chǔ vs zhū); same part in 煮 zhǔ and 著 zhù.
⺼ (flesh, from 肉) — marks body parts, as in 肚 belly, 脸 face, 腿 leg; 膜 is a membrane, a thin layer of tissue.
莫 (mò) — same sound: 膜 mó. 莫 also sounds out 摸 mō and 幕 mù.
弓 (bow) — marks bows and stretching, as in 张 stretch, 引 draw; 弘 is expanding, like a bow drawn wide.
犭 (animal; 犬 dog) — marks animals, as in 狗 dog, 猫 cat, 猪 pig; 狄 was a northern tribe, written with the animal radical; today mostly a name.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 泼 is splashing or pouring water.
发 (fā) — close sound: 泼 pō. 发 also sounds out 拨 bō and 废 fèi.
戈 (dagger-axe) — marks weapons and cutting, as in 战 battle, 伐 fell; 截 is cutting off a piece, as in 截止 cut-off.
